column3: >","In art and nature, beauty often evokes a sense of pleasure and harmony, while the sublime stirs awe and a hint of terror, transcending mere beauty.","Beauty and the sublime intersect in their shared ability to evoke strong emotional responses, yet they differ in the nature of these responses.
